executionArgs.additionalInstruction: The test server runs on localhost:5000 and translates /rest/v1/{table} to internal routes. Use PostgREST-style params: ?id=eq.{uuid} for filtering. POST returns 201 on success. PATCH returns 200. DELETE returns 200. GET with ?id=eq.{uuid} returns a JSON array. For products: POST /rest/v1/products with {name, price, unit, category_id}. For categories: POST /rest/v1/categories with {name, color, sort_order}. For couriers: POST /rest/v1/couriers with {name, phone, is_active}. For orders: POST /rest/v1/orders with {customer_id, address_id, items: [{product_id, quantity, unit, unit_price}], payment_method, status}. For addresses: POST /rest/v1/customer_addresses with {customer_id, title, address_text, latitude, longitude, is_default}. PATCH /rest/v1/orders?id=eq.{id} with {status} to update status. PATCH /rest/v1/orders/courier?id=eq.{id} with {courier_id} to assign courier.
